name: Wealth Management & Private Banking
description: Advisory and brokerage assets, flows, fee rates, and lending to high-net-worth clients.

metrics.name: client_assets
metrics.description: Client assets (AUM plus AUA) at a point in time

metrics.name: net_new_assets
metrics.description: Client inflows minus outflows in the period, excluding market moves

metrics.name: fee_rate
metrics.description: Annualized advisory fees divided by average fee-based assets

metrics.name: advisor_count
metrics.description: Advisors at a point in time

metrics.name: client_lending_balances
metrics.description: Securities-based and mortgage lending to clients

conventions.rule: Separate asset change into net new assets and market movement; never report a market-driven rise as growth.
AUM (discretionary) and AUA (custody/brokerage) earn different fees; label which.

insight_rules.reason: Fee rate is balance-weighted; decompose into pricing and mix effects.

caveats.text: Client assets move with markets; pair with a market index before attributing change to the business.

chart_conventions.rule: Show asset change as a bridge (waterfall-style table): opening, net new assets, market, other, closing.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
